title: The Weekly Challenge - 384
task1_desc: You are given a number and a base integer. Write a script to convert the given number in the given base integer.
task2_desc: You are given a binary string. Write a script to return all non-empty substrings (distinct) that have the same number of 0's and 1's, and all the 0's and all the 1's in these substrings are grouped consecutively.
